title: The Second Thirst
summary: Strahd is destroyed, but the thirst he carried finds a new home in one of you.

epilogue.title: Barovia
epilogue.text: The mists do not lift. The valley learns a new name to whisper, and finds it fits the same old fear.

epilogue.title: The New Lord
epilogue.text: {name} takes the high chair in the castle hall. The thirst is patient at first. It was patient with the one before, too.

epilogue.title: Old Friends
epilogue.text: The rest of you could leave now; the mists part for the new lord's friends. Whether you stay is a question {name} asks every night.

epilogue.title: Ireena Kolyana
epilogue.text: Ireena leaves the castle on the morning {name} stops casting a reflection. She does not say goodbye.

epilogue.title: Ireena Kolyana
epilogue.text: Ireena hears that the devil is dead and an heir sits in his chair. She does not wait to learn what kind of lord the heir will be.
